testSet.name: test-v3
testSet.note: Fresh postings never in the eval (including Nortal, Praxent, Able, ThriveCart and the daily ingests). Same sampling rules as test-v2 (<= 25 per company, <= 3 per vacancy). Last cycle (ADR 0004): if it does not meet the criterion nothing is iterated again; it is accepted with the documented gap (ADR 0005).

devLabelRevision.scope: dev split only; the frozen test split is untouched
rules: A case whose body explicitly says hybrid/onsite, or whose body is silent and whose ATS workplaceType is hybrid/onsite, gets workModel hybrid/onsite and label onsite_or_hybrid (ADR 0004 sections 3 and 6).
D5: 'Americas' counts as latam_eligible unless the body restricts the role further.

revisions.scope: development split (160 cases, including the retired test-v1)
rules: ADR 0004 section 3: body explicitly hybrid/onsite, or silent body + ATS workplaceType hybrid/onsite => workModel hybrid/onsite and label onsite_or_hybrid.
ADR 0004 labelling guide, patterns 1-4 (team distribution, 'work from anywhere' benefit, composite locations, non-Latin titles).
ADR 0004 guide rule 5: on doubt or contradiction the conservative (non-applicable) label wins.
A time zone alone ("Central time zone") does not restrict to a country (D5).
"remote-first" vs "committed to hybrid work": onsite_or_hybrid if the role has an assigned city/office, otherwise unclear. Never applicable.
keptAsIs: greenhouse:sezzle:7984978003 (latam_eligible by pattern 3, accepted by the owner)

revisions.scope: development split: evidence QC (cases whose evidence was missing or not literal in the posting)
rules: Evidence must be a literal quote of the title, location or body (or verified metadata form).
ADR 0004 guide rule 6 (remote-first with periodic travel is remote; hybrid = regular weekly presence).

retiredTestSets.name: test-v1
retiredTestSets.reason: The set was seen by eligibility-v3 (one approved run, precision below the 95 % goal). A test set that has already been seen cannot accept v4 without bias, so it was retired and its 112 cases moved to the development split (160 development cases in total).

retiredTestSets.name: test-v2

preRunChanges.note: Made before any model run on test-v2 (owner decisions and rule 6 of the ADR 0004 labelling guide); each case keeps relabeledFrom.

retiredTestSets.jointReading: test-v1 (v3 + postprocess-v1) and test-v2 (v4 + postprocess-v2), two independent tests, give about 91 % precision and 96 % recall for gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Tuning the prompt raised development but not the test sets.
retiredTestSets.reason: The set was seen by eligibility-v4 (one approved run, precision 90.7 % below the 95 % goal). A set that has already been seen cannot accept a later version without bias, so it was retired and its 157 cases moved to development (317 in total).
